ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated in discrete, localized clusters covering approximately 5-10% of the visible surface area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid black base pigmentation with high-contrast white circular and elliptical blobs (rosettes) scattered across both lobes; a high-density cluster of high-intensity pixels is located on the distal tip of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with an estimated internal angle of 42 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 1/8th of the lobe width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern across the entire trailing edge; pixel amplitudes of individual peaks range from 3 to 12 pixels relative to the smoothed curve.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, tapering to sharp, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous high-contrast white ring-shaped pixel clusters (barnacle scars) distributed across the central and outer portions of both lobes, notably on the lower-medial left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Subtle, unaligned horizontal and vertical white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) visible on the medial surface of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular semi-circular indentation on the trailing edge of the left lobe approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch to the tip; extensive circular scarring across the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense cluster of white spots forming a distinct triangular formation on the extreme distal edge of the left lobe.
